intro.title: Genuine sports nutrition in Tashkent
intro.p1: {brand} is the place to buy protein, mass gainers, creatine and other sports nutrition in one store. The catalog covers whey protein, isolate and casein, gainers for bulking, creatine monohydrate, BCAA and amino acids, pre-workouts, fat burners, vitamins and omega-3.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: Yes. {brand} sells only genuine, certified sports nutrition: the brand, country of manufacture and expiry date of every product are tracked.
faq.q2: What is the difference between protein, a gainer and creatine?
faq.a2: Protein supports muscle growth and recovery. A gainer mixes protein and carbohydrates for gaining weight and mass. Creatine improves strength and endurance. Our operator will help you choose for your goal.
faq.q3: How do delivery and pickup work?
faq.a3: Orders are delivered across Tashkent and Uzbekistan. You can also pick up your order from the nearest store — addresses and opening hours are on the Stores page.
faq.a4: Our loyalty programme: every purchase earns cashback coins, and the rate grows with your tier. 1 coin = 1 so'm — pay part of your next order with coins.
faq.a5: In cash or by card. The payment methods available right now are shown at checkout.
